dimensions.assessment: Affects financial markets, investors, and developing countries receiving loans and grants from the International Development Association.
dimensions.evidence: The association provides loans and grants to developing countries.

dimensions.assessment: Aligns regulatory treatment with other multilateral development banks, altering securities compliance requirements.
dimensions.evidence: accord securities issued by the International Development Association the same exemption from the securities laws that applies to the securities of other multilateral development banks

dimensions.assessment: Potentially affects transaction costs and capital-raising ability for the International Development Association, though no specific federal budget outlays are stated.
Amends the International Development Association Act to add securities exemptions and SEC reporting provisions.
dimensions.evidence: Any securities issued by the Association... shall be deemed to be exempted securities within the meaning of section 3(a)(2) of the Securities Act of 1933

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory exemption unless suspended by the SEC or triggered by a Treasury terrorism financing report.

missing_information: Total monetary value of securities expected to be issued under the exemption
importance_detail.rationale: The bill exempts securities issued by the World Bank's International Development Association from certain securities regulations unless the Treasury reports financial support to state sponsors of terrorism.
